name: 手动运输计划 (6W2)
description_en_html:
Overview

Manual planning allows you to create or change a transportation plan. To create a transportation plan, you assign transportation demands (such as freight unit stages) to transportation capacities (such as equipment types, for example, truck types, railcar types, or container types). The system creates capacity documents (freight orders or freight bookings). Scheduling runs automatically after you perform a planning activity for a road freight order. You can then create deliveries for these freight documents.

Key Process Flow

  • Supports various activities for freight documents, such as road freight order, rail freight order, ocean freight booking, air freight booking, and advanced intercompany documents
  • Perform manual transportation planning for freight documents created in your transportation process
  • Perform subcontracting for relevant freight documents
  • Receive confirmation for involved freight documents
  • Trigger delivery creation

Business Benefits

  • Support your company's transportation planning in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Reduce freight costs with early transportation planning capabilities based on orders
  • Get fewer delivery changes during logistics execution with late delivery creation based on the transportation plan and warehouse activity closeness
  • Improve on-time deliveries
description_zh_html:
概览

手动计划允许您创建或更改运输计划。要创建运输计划，请将运输需求（例如货运单位阶段）分配到运输容量（例如设备类型，例如卡车类型、铁路车类型或集装箱类型）。系统创建容量凭证（货运订单或货运预订）。为公路货运订单执行计划活动后，将自动运行计划。然后，您可以为这些货运凭证创建交货。

关键流程流

  • 支持货运凭证的各种活动，例如公路货运订单、铁路货运订单、海运预订、空运预订和高级公司间凭证
  • 为在运输流程中创建的货运凭证执行手动运输计划。
  • 执行相关货运凭证的转包
  • 接收所涉及货运凭证的确认
  • 触发交货创建

业务优势

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中支持公司的运输计划
  • 借助基于订单的早期运输计划功能，降低货运成本
  • 通过基于运输计划和仓库活动的延迟交货创建，减少物流执行期间的交货更改
  • 提高按时交付率
